confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Santiago prices. No live menus, listings or booking pages were checked, and city prices were not sourced by web search. Local CLP prices were converted at an assumed approximate rate, not a live quote. Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation and the mid-range dinner are less certain. Cocktail and wine anchors lean on the local beer relationship (cocktail about 1.9x draft beer, wine glass about 1.2x) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. July is a lower-demand winter month for Santiago city tourism, so accommodation sits in the lower-middle of its range. The FX figure was surfaced by search from RBA exchange-rate data; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Santiago-specific general knowledge, placed regionally: among the higher-priced South American capitals for dining and hotels (above Lima and Bogota) and well below North American or Western European capitals. No single comparable city was used as a priced reference.
